command:
import os,sys
conn=None
cert=None
def f():
 import psycopg
 from backend.container.rds_config import parse_application_secret,materialize_rds_ca_bundle,application_dsn
 raw=os.environ.get('NOVAMIND_POSTGRES_SECRET')
 if not raw: raise ValueError()
 sec=parse_application_secret(raw)
 cert=materialize_rds_ca_bundle(sec.rds_ca_pem)
 conn=psycopg.connect(application_dsn(sec,certificate_path=cert),connect_timeout=10)
 conn.read_only=True
 with conn.transaction():
  with conn.cursor() as cur:
   cur.execute("SELECT CASE WHEN count(*)=0 THEN 'ABSENT' WHEN bool_and(pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner)='novamind_app') THEN 'OWNED_BY_APP' ELSE 'OTHER_OWNER' END FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='novamind' AND p.proname='novamind_workflow_guard' AND pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid)= ''")
   row=cur.fetchone()
 if not row or row[0] not in {'ABSENT','OWNED_BY_APP','OTHER_OWNER'}: raise ValueError()
 return row[0],conn,cert
try:
 out,conn,cert=f()
 print(out)
except Exception:
 print('DIAGNOSTIC_ERROR')
 sys.exit(1)
finally:
 try:
  if conn: conn.close()
 except Exception: pass
 try:
  if cert: os.unlink(cert)
 except Exception: pass
